result.topic_en: Gauss defines the theta series p, q, r in μ and their two-variable analogues P, R in x, states product formulas for pP±rR and rP±pR as squares, derives a square-root identity, and begins examining the logarithmic-derivative expression PP''−P'P'.
result.transcription:
Es sei
$1+2\mu^4+2\mu^{16}+2\mu^{36}+\cdots = p$
$2\mu+2\mu^9+2\mu^{25}+2\mu^{49}+\ldots = r$
woraus zugleich
$1-2\mu^4+2\mu^{16}-2\mu^{36}\ldots = q$ gesetzt
$p^4=q^4+r^4$ wird, ingleichen wenn $p,q,r$ in
$p',q',r'$ übergehen indem $\mu$ in $\mu\mu$ verwandelt wird,
ist $2p'p' = pp+qq$
$q'q' = pq$
sodann
$1+\mu^4(xx+x^{-2})+\mu^{16}(x^4+x^{-4})+\mu^{36}(x^6+x^{-6})+\cdots = P$
$\mu(x+x^{-1})+\mu^9(x^3+x^{-3})+\mu^{25}(x^5+x^{-5})+\cdots = R$
so wird
$pP+rR = \{1+\mu\mu(x^{\frac12}+x^{-\frac12})+\mu^8(x+x^{-1})+\mu^{18}(x^{\frac32}+x^{-\frac32})+\ldots\}^2$
$pP-rR = \{1-\mu\mu(x^{\frac12}+x^{-\frac12})+\mu^8(x+x^{-1})-\mu^{18}(x^{\frac32}+x^{-\frac32})+\ldots\}^2$
$rP+pR = \{\mu^{\frac12}(x^{\frac12}+x^{-\frac12})+\mu^{\frac92}(x^{\frac32}+x^{-\frac32})+\mu^{\frac{25}{2}}(x^{\frac52}+x^{-\frac52})+\ldots\}^2$
$rP-pR = \{\mu^{\frac12}(x^{\frac12}-x^{-\frac12})-\mu^{\frac92}(x^{\frac32}-x^{-\frac32})+\mu^{\frac{25}{2}}(x^{\frac52}-x^{-\frac52})-\ldots\}^2$
Daraus folgt dann
$\sqrt{(ppPP-rrRR)(rrPP-ppRR)} = (1-2\mu^4+2\mu^{16}-2\mu^{36}\ldots)(1-\mu^4(x+x^{-1})+\mu^{16}(xx+x^{-2})-\ldots)$
$\times(1-2\mu^4+2\mu^{16}-2\mu^{36}\ldots)\{\mu(x-x^{-1})-\mu^9(x^3-x^{-3})+\mu^{25}(x^5-x^{-5})$
Es ist ferner $P'=\frac{x\,dP}{dx}$, $P''=\frac{x\,dP'}{dx}$ gesetzt
$PP''-P'P'$ [-RR-] $= APP+BRR$ wo $A,B$ kein $x$ enthalten
[-ohne $x$ oder function von $\mu$-] $=\frac{8x^8+32x^{32}+72x^{72}+80[?]}{xx+x^{18}+x^{50}+x^{98}+}$
[scheint unrichtig]
$=\frac{8(1+2x^8+2x^{32}+2x^{72}+\ldots)}{xx+x^{18}+x^{50}+x^{98}\ldots}\{\frac{x^8}{1-x^{16}}-\frac{2x^{16}}{1-x^{32}}+\frac{3x^{24}}{1-x^{48}}-$
$=\frac{8(1+2x^8\ldots}{xx+x^{18}\ldots}\ \{\frac{x^8}{(1+x^8)^2}+\frac{x^{16}}{(1+x^{16})^2}++\}$

methods.what: Definition of theta series p, r, q
Landen/AGM-type duplication formulas for theta constants under μ→μ²
Product formulas expressing pP±rR, rP±pR as squares of theta series
Square-root identity derived from the product formulas
Logarithmic-derivative expression PP''−P'P' as combination of P² and R² with x-free coefficients

items.english: PP''−P'P' = A·PP + B·RR, where A, B contain no x.
